user_story: As a user, I want to see 'Hello World!' displayed after clicking the 'Start' button so that I can confirm that the content loads asynchronously.
cypress_script: describe('Asynchronously Loaded Content', () => { it('should display Hello World! after clicking Start', () => { cy.visit('https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/dynamic_loading/1'); cy.get('#start button').click(); cy.get('#finish').should('contain', 'Hello World!'); }); it('should not display Hello World! before clicking Start', () => { cy.visit('https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/dynamic_loading/1'); cy.get('#finish').should('not.exist'); }); });
playwright_script: import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'; test('Asynchronously Loaded Content', async ({ page }) => { await page.goto('https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/dynamic_loading/1'); await page.click('#start button'); await expect(page.locator('#finish')).toHaveText('Hello World!'); }); test('should not display Hello World! before clicking Start', async ({ page }) => { await page.goto('https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/dynamic_loading/1'); const finishLocator = page.locator('#finish'); await expect(finishLocator).toHaveCount(0); }); });
